paragraphs.shown: This is an illustrative sample made from Hrizzup's example story. Delhi's air has turned severe.

Before dawn on Monday, AQI readings in Delhi, Noida and Gurugram crossed 450, the worst of the season so far. The city's emergency rules are in force: building work has stopped, and diesel trucks are kept out of Delhi.
What does this mean for you? Doctors advise people with breathing problems to stay indoors. The emergency rules also ask offices to let staff work from home where they can.

Schools changed twice. On Monday, an update said schools across Delhi NCR had moved online until Friday. On Tuesday, a correction said only Delhi's primary schools have. Schools in Noida and Gurugram remain open.
What isn't confirmed is how long Delhi's primary schools stay online. The first update said until Friday, but the correction doesn't repeat it.
